text: SYMPTOM
SAFE RESPONSE
API disconnected
Pause new mutations; check connection state, refresh once, escalate with time and correlation reference.
textPreview: Pause new mutations; check connection state, refresh once, escalate with time and correlation reference.

text: 409 conflict / stale version
Refresh the record, compare the newer change, then reapply only your intended update.
textPreview: Refresh the record, compare the newer change, then reapply only your intended update.

text: Permission denied
Verify role, tenant and record scope. Ask an administrator—do not use another person's account.
textPreview: Verify role, tenant and record scope. Ask an administrator—do not use another person's account.

text: Resource unavailable
Check active/compliant status and overlapping work; choose another eligible resource or reschedule.
textPreview: Check active/compliant status and overlapping work; choose another eligible resource or reschedule.

text: Weight exception
Verify units and ticket inputs; review tolerance and evidence; record a reasoned approval/override if authorised.
textPreview: Verify units and ticket inputs; review tolerance and evidence; record a reasoned approval/override if authorised.

text: Upload rejected
Check allowed type, extension, size and signature; retry the same valid file without changing the business record.
textPreview: Check allowed type, extension, size and signature; retry the same valid file without changing the business record.

text: Offline command conflict
Reconnect, review queued status and current trip state; do not repeat lifecycle actions blindly.
textPreview: Reconnect, review queued status and current trip state; do not repeat lifecycle actions blindly.
